pages.label: About Company
pages.heading: About Company
pages.description: Agriculture Square began as a single family farm and has grown into a network of certified growers supplying partners across three continents. We still farm the way we started: paying attention.
points: Founded in 2009 with 40 hectares under cultivation
Now operating across 1,200 hectares and 6 regional co-operatives
ISO 22000 and Global G.A.P. certified end to end

pages.label: Case Study
pages.heading: Case Study
pages.challenge: Greenfield's 300-hectare cooperative faced declining soil fertility and inconsistent irrigation scheduling.
pages.solution: We introduced soil sensor networks, a rotational cropping plan, and drip irrigation tied to live moisture data.
pages.outcome: Within three growing seasons, yield rose 42% and water usage dropped by a third.
